faq.q: How is a titanium pedal traction pin manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium pedal traction pin is manufactured using Wire drawing; CNC swaging; CNC turning; Thread rolling. BOZE CNC Ti uses precision CNC equipment with strict process controls to ensure consistent quality and dimensional accuracy.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for titanium pedal traction pin?
faq.a: Alternative materials include stainless steel (heavier, susceptible to corrosion) and aluminum (lower strength, shorter fatigue life). The alternative manufacturing method is Centerless grinding from bar stock (higher material waste, longer lead time).

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium pedal traction pin?
faq.a: Titanium Pedal Traction Pin components are typically manufactured to ASTM B348. Additional customer-specific specifications may apply.

faq.q: What are common failure modes for titanium pedal traction pin?
faq.a: Common failure modes include Surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (ASTM F86). BOZE CNC Ti mitigates these through strict process control, proper material selection, and 100% inspection.
